_README: AUTHORITATIVE SOURCE OF TRUTH for Solar London's quote catalog.
This file is the file Raymon edits. The identical content is pasted as the
`const CATALOG` literal into the `Load Catalog` Code node of the quote
sub-workflow. The two MUST be byte-identical, proven by `catalog_checksum`.
PRICING BLOCKER (see spec section 2): Raymon's only price datum, verbatim, is:
it depends on what the person pick it a solar panel let say it about 6k pounds
That sentence is ambiguous (per panel? per install? VAT-inclusive? real or illustrative?) and is
recorded ONLY as provenance of an open question. It must NEVER be parsed into a price, used as a
default, or used to bound any value.
RULES:
1. EVERY price-bearing field is the literal string "TBD" until Raymon supplies a value in writing.
2. Money fields are STRINGS on purpose. A number field cannot hold "TBD" without a type lie, and a
type lie is exactly how a default price sneaks in. The pricing Code node parses money with
/^\d{1,9}(\.\d{1,2})?$/ and treats anything else as UNRESOLVED, which ABORTS the quote.
3. NEVER invent, infer, round, extrapolate, or "reasonably assume" any price, discount, VAT rate,
turnaround, panel wattage, finance rate, or payment term.
4. If a price needed for a requested service is still "TBD" at quote time, the workflow must ABORT
the quote and reply with a human-handoff line. It must never emit a partial quote, a zero, a
range, a "from ..." figure, or a model-invented number.
FIELD TYPES:
key                string  stable snake_case. The ONLY thing the agent may pass. Never shown to the lead.
display_name       string  customer-facing name, printed on the quote.
category           enum    installation | storage | bundle | maintenance | removal | finance
install_type       enum    home | commercial | both
pricing_model      enum    flat | per_unit | per_watt | TBD   (Raymon chooses, per service)
unit_label         string  e.g. per install / per panel / per watt. Must come from Raymon, never
be inferred from pricing_model.
unit_size          string  only meaningful for per_watt (panel wattage). "TBD" until supplied.
unit_price         string  THE PRICE. See rule 2.
currency           string  GBP (fixed by decision: GBP).
vat_included       enum    yes | no | TBD
includes           string[] bullet deliverables. ["TBD"] until supplied.
excludes           string[] bullet exclusions. ["TBD"] until supplied.
turnaround         string  install timeframe. "TBD" until supplied. Never inferred.
lead_time_note     string  optional extra line. "TBD" if needed.
active             bool    false rows are never quoted.
requires_quote_id  bool    if true, this row may only appear on a formal numbered quote, not in chat.
ROW KEYS BELOW ARE PROPOSED, NOT CONFIRMED. Raymon renames, adds, or deletes freely.
See spec section 17.2, questions 11-14.
checksum_note: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of this file's canonical JSON form: keys sorted, no whitespace, UTF-8. Computed once at roadmap stage S1 and written into BOTH this field and the `catalog_checksum` inside the `Load Catalog` Code node. A mismatch is a hard stop at S1 and at every catalog update thereafter.

document_defaults._note: Printed on every quote. All from Raymon, all verified against facts.json before the PDF ships.

services.raymon_question: Q1/Q2/Q4/Q6: is the ~6k per panel or per home install? VAT included? Does the price vary with panel count, and if so what is the base plus the per-panel figure? How long does a home install take?
Q11/Q12: is battery storage a separate quoteable line for home installs? How is it priced - flat, per unit, or per unit of storage capacity? If capacity-based, what is the capacity unit and its size?

Q11: is a solar-plus-battery bundle quoted as its own line, or as the two component lines added together? If it is a bundle, is the bundle price discounted relative to the components - and if so, that discount figure is a number Raymon must give us.
Q1/Q6: is commercial solar priced the same way as home, or differently? Is it always a site-survey-only estimate rather than a fixed price? What is the turnaround for a commercial install?

Q11/Q12: do you quote maintenance and monitoring as a line item, and is it recurring (per year) or one-off? If recurring, what is the billing period - this is the one place the catalog may legitimately need a period word in `unit_label`.
Q11/Q12/Q10: is repair / fault rectification quoted as a flat call-out, a call-out plus parts, or only after a survey? Are call-out, parts, and labour separate lines or one figure?
Q11: is EV charger installation part of what Solar London quotes? If yes, is it tied to a panel count, or quoted on its own? Does it share the same pricing model as the panel install?
Q11: do you quote removal / decommissioning? If so, is it per panel or a fixed job?

Q9: is finance offered, and from which provider? If finance appears on a quote, is it quoted as a line with its own figure, or mentioned in the summary only? If it carries a figure or an APR, that is a number Raymon must give us - we will not infer one.

forbidden_services_note: These four came from the old marketing-agency catalog. They are NOT Solar London services. If any of them ever appears in a matched service list, a document, or a chat message, the build has regressed. `must_not_contain` in facts.json enforces this.

verification.tbd_count_command_note: Before stage S4 the Builder should confirm this file contains zero occurrences of the literal string "TBD" in any price-bearing field. Command shape: a plain text search for '"unit_price": "TBD"' and for '"TBD"' inside unit_price / unit_size / pricing_model / vat_included / turnaround. Any hit means stage S1 is not finished.
verification.no_placeholder_in_output: The `Build Quote Document` Code node scans the rendered HTML for the pattern \[YOUR_[A-Z_]+\] and ABORTS the quote if anything matches. The old workflow shipped [YOUR_AGENCY_NAME], [YOUR_NAME], [YOUR_EMAIL], [YOUR_PHONE], [YOUR_LOCATION] straight to customers; that defect must not come back.
verification.fail_loud_rule: AGENTS.md section 9.7. If any price needed for a requested service is unresolved at quote time, the quote ABORTS and the lead receives a pre-written human-handoff line. It must never receive a partial quote, a zero, or a model-invented number.
